dialogue.origin: こんにちは。本日は宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Hello. Thank you for coming today.

dialogue.origin: (よろしくお願いいたします。何かリクエストとかありますか？)
dialogue.content: (Thank you. Do you have any requests or preferences?)

dialogue.origin: すみません、リクエストとは、クライエントのリクエストのことでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, when you say "requests," do you mean requests for the client's role?

dialogue.origin: (はい、相談内容や年齢層などのご希望ありましたら伺います)
dialogue.content: (Yes, if you have any preferences for the consultation topic, age group, etc., I can accommodate them.)

dialogue.origin: （やはりそうなんですね、すべてが勉強ですので、何でも頑張ってみます。ありがとうございます）
dialogue.content: (I see, so that's what you meant. Everything is a learning opportunity, so I'll do my best with anything. Thank you.)

dialogue.origin: (はい、承知しました)
dialogue.content: (Yes, understood.)

dialogue.origin: （時間になりましたら、始めさせていただきますね。）
dialogue.content: (When it's time, I’ll get us started.)

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。本日はお越しいただき、ありがとうございます。初めに、年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming today. First, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 14歳　女子です
dialogue.content: I'm a 14-year-old girl.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。今日は、どのような相談でしょう？
dialogue.content: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 友だちのことです
dialogue.content: It's about my friends.

dialogue.origin: 友達とは、学校の友達ですか？
dialogue.content: Are these school friends?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 何かあったのか、言える範囲で教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me what happened, to the extent you're comfortable sharing?

dialogue.origin: 3人で仲良くしてたんだけど
dialogue.content: The three of us were good friends, but...

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: 最近わたしだけハブられてる
dialogue.content: Lately, I'm the only one being left out.

dialogue.origin: それは悲しいですね。
dialogue.content: That must be very sad.

dialogue.origin: 音楽教室から帰る時、置いて行かれたり
dialogue.content: Like, when we're leaving music class, they'll just go without me.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: ほかにもあります？
dialogue.content: Has anything else happened?

dialogue.origin: 家庭科の授業中、2人だけで楽しそうにしてたり
dialogue.content: And during home economics class, they'll have fun just the two of them.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 嫌になって
dialogue.content: I got fed up,

dialogue.origin: 離れました
dialogue.content: so I've distanced myself.

dialogue.origin: とても悲しいことがあったんですね
dialogue.content: It sounds like something very upsetting happened to you.

dialogue.origin: 最近とはいつ頃からですか？
dialogue.content: When you say "recently," about how long has it been?

dialogue.origin: 2週間くらいかな
dialogue.content: About two weeks ago, I think.

dialogue.origin: ほんとに最近まで、仲良くしてたんですね
dialogue.content: So you were all getting along well until just recently.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: なのに、そんなことになって、悲しいですね。二週間前に、何かきっかけのようなものは、あったんですか？
dialogue.content: It must be sad for things to turn out like this, then. Was there anything that might have triggered this two weeks ago?

dialogue.origin: わかんないです
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: 急にそんなことになったんですね。それはもやもやしますよね。
dialogue.content: So it just happened all of a sudden. That must be so confusing and frustrating.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Yes, it is.

dialogue.origin: その子たちに、何か聞いたりしたことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Have you tried asking them about it?

dialogue.origin: 先生に話して、1人の子と話したら、寝たら忘れるって言われてムカつきました
dialogue.content: I talked to my teacher, and when I spoke to one of the girls, she told me to "just sleep it off and forget about it," which really ticked me off.

dialogue.origin: それはひどいですね。ちゃんと話をしたかったですよね。
dialogue.content: That's a terrible thing to say. You just wanted to have a proper talk about it, didn't you?

dialogue.origin: ひどいですよね
dialogue.content: It's awful, right?

dialogue.origin: ひどいと思いますよ。傷つきますよね。
dialogue.content: I think it's terrible. That must have been very hurtful.

dialogue.origin: そーなんです
dialogue.content: It was.

dialogue.origin: では、その時は何も進展なかったのですね
dialogue.content: So, nothing was resolved at that time, then.

dialogue.origin: はい、それで、もう1人の子と話そうか迷ってて、、
dialogue.content: Right. And now, I'm wondering if I should talk to the other girl...

dialogue.origin: どうしたらいいと思いますか？
dialogue.content: What do you think I should do?

dialogue.origin: 迷っているんですね？因みに、何と呼んで良いでしょうか？
dialogue.content: You're feeling unsure. By the way, what should I call you?

dialogue.origin: みくです
dialogue.content: Miku.

dialogue.origin: みくさん、もう一人の子とは、話せそうです？
dialogue.content: Miku, do you feel like you could talk to the other girl?

dialogue.origin: うーん、それがどうしたらいいかわかんなくて
dialogue.content: Hmm, I just don't know how to go about it.

dialogue.origin: どうやってはなしたらいいかわかんない
dialogue.content: I don't know how to start the conversation.

dialogue.origin: 話しかけるきっかけが？
dialogue.content: So you're not sure how to start the conversation?

dialogue.origin: それも不安
dialogue.content: That makes me anxious, too.

dialogue.origin: ええ、不安ですよね
dialogue.content: Yes, I can understand why you'd be anxious.

dialogue.origin: 他にも心配なことあります？
dialogue.content: Are there other things you're worried about?

dialogue.origin: えー、他にも？そう言われるといっぱいある気がする
dialogue.content: Uh, other things? Now that you mention it, I feel like there are a lot.

dialogue.origin: 勉強もできないしね
dialogue.content: I can't study well, either.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、たくさんありすぎて、
dialogue.content: Right, there are so many things...

dialogue.origin: お金もないし
dialogue.content: And I don't have any money,

dialogue.origin: 遊べない
dialogue.content: so I can't go out and have fun.

dialogue.origin: 何も手につかなくなりそうですね
dialogue.content: It must feel like you can’t focus on anything.

dialogue.origin: 親もうるさいし
dialogue.content: And my parents are always on my case.

dialogue.origin: だるー
dialogue.content: It's such a drag.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: もう一人の子とは、話したいですか？
dialogue.content: Do you want to talk to the other girl?

dialogue.origin: そうですね。。
dialogue.content: Well... I think so.

dialogue.origin: 聞きたいですよね
dialogue.content: You want to ask her what's going on, don't you?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 何か話せる雰囲気になれると良いですが、そんな時はありそう？
dialogue.content: It would be good to find a natural moment to talk. Do you think there might be an opportunity like that?

dialogue.origin: それがどうしたらいいかわかんない
dialogue.content: That's the thing, I don't know how to do that.

dialogue.origin: うんうん、難しいですね
dialogue.content: Yeah, that’s difficult.

dialogue.origin: お家は遠いですか？
dialogue.content: Do you live far from each other?

dialogue.origin: その子と美玖さんのお家
dialogue.content: Her house and yours, Miku.

dialogue.origin: みくさんですね
dialogue.content: Miku, I mean.

dialogue.origin: 30ぷん暗い
dialogue.content: About 30 minutes.

dialogue.origin: くらい
dialogue.content: or so.

dialogue.origin: かな
dialogue.content: I guess.

dialogue.origin: じゃあ、登下校中とかは難しそうかな？
dialogue.content: So, talking on the way to or from school might be difficult, then?

dialogue.origin: でも、なんて言っていいかわかんない
dialogue.content: But I don't know what to say.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、直接はわからなくなりそうですね。緊張もしちゃいますよね。
dialogue.content: Right, it's hard to know what to say when you're face-to-face. You'd probably get nervous, too.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: Exactly.

dialogue.origin: このことは、他の友達に話したことあります？
dialogue.content: Have you talked to any other friends about this?

dialogue.origin: ないです
dialogue.content: No.

dialogue.origin: 誰か話せそうな人はいる？
dialogue.content: Is there anyone you feel you could talk to?

dialogue.origin: いない
dialogue.content: No one.

dialogue.origin: 他に仲良い友達もいないし
dialogue.content: I don't have any other close friends.

dialogue.origin: 今までの友達が、大好きだったんだね
dialogue.content: So you really loved those friends, didn't you?

dialogue.origin: なのに、こんなことになって、本当に悲しいよね
dialogue.content: It's so sad that this has happened to you.

dialogue.origin: うーん、大好きっていうか中学入ってからずっと仲良かったし、ふつうに一緒にいた感じだから
dialogue.content: Hmm, "loved" isn't quite the right word. We've just been close ever since we started middle school, and we were always hanging out together.

dialogue.origin: うんうん
dialogue.content: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.origin: だから今は学校もうざい
dialogue.content: That's why school is such a pain now.

dialogue.origin: そうだよね、そうなっちゃうよね
dialogue.content: I can understand that. It makes sense you'd feel that way.

dialogue.origin: 例えば、前に同じような経験はある？
dialogue.content: For example, have you ever had a similar experience before?

dialogue.origin: ないです
dialogue.content: No.

dialogue.origin: 小学校のときとか
dialogue.content: Like, in elementary school?

dialogue.origin: ないんだね
dialogue.content: So you haven't.

dialogue.origin: 学校では、今一人でいる感じかな？
dialogue.content: So at school now, do you feel like you're mostly by yourself?

dialogue.origin: そう、だからつまんない
dialogue.content: Yeah, so it's boring.

dialogue.origin: つまんないよね
dialogue.content: That does sound boring.

dialogue.origin: さっき言ってた先生は、話聞いてくれるかな？
dialogue.content: The teacher you mentioned earlier, do you think they would listen to you again?

dialogue.origin: どうかな、、わかんない
dialogue.content: I wonder... I don't know.

dialogue.origin: もう一度相談したら、何ていうかな
dialogue.content: What do you think they would say if you went to them again?

dialogue.origin: またか、っていうかもと思うと言いづらい
dialogue.content: I'm worried they'll think, "This again?" and that makes it hard to bring up.

dialogue.origin: ほんとだね、言いづらいよね
dialogue.content: That's true, it is hard to bring it up.

dialogue.origin: みくさんの気持ちは、もう一度仲良くしたいのかな？
dialogue.content: Miku, deep down, do you want to be friends with them again?

dialogue.origin: うん、やっぱり前みたいに3人で仲良くできたらなって思うけど、あっちはどう思ってるかわかんない
dialogue.content: Yeah, I do wish the three of us could get along like before, but I don't know how they feel.

dialogue.origin: もう私なんていらないと思ってるんじゃないかな
dialogue.content: I bet they think they don't need me anymore.

dialogue.origin: 仲良くしたいんだね。でも、みくさんのことどう思ってるかわからないから、聞くのが怖いんだね
dialogue.content: So you want to be friends again. But you're scared to ask because you don't know how they feel about you.

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's it.

dialogue.origin: あきらめてるとこもある？
dialogue.content: Is there a part of you that's starting to give up?

dialogue.origin: そういわれるとそうかもしれない
dialogue.content: Now that you say it, maybe so.

dialogue.origin: 直接は難しいし、伝えてくれそうな友達もいない。他に何かみくさんの気持ちを、伝える方法は何かないかしら。
dialogue.content: Talking to them directly is difficult, and you don't have a mutual friend who could act as a go-between. I wonder if there's any other way to convey your feelings.

dialogue.origin: それがわかんないです
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: そうだよね
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 私も同じようなことがあって、その時はお手紙を書いてみましたよ。すごくドキドキしたけど、正直にかいてみたの。
dialogue.content: I had a similar experience once, and I tried writing a letter. My heart was pounding, but I wrote down my honest feelings.

dialogue.origin: みくさんの件が、上手くいくかは分からないけど、そんな方法もありますよ
dialogue.content: I don't know if it will work in your case, Miku, but it's one possible method.

dialogue.origin: どう思いますか？
dialogue.content: What do you think?

dialogue.origin: 手紙ね。。自信ないけど考えてみます
dialogue.content: A letter... I'm not confident, but I'll think about it.

dialogue.origin: ドキドキしますよね。
dialogue.content: It is nerve-wracking, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: バカみたいって思われないかな
dialogue.content: Won't they think I'm being stupid?

dialogue.origin: うざいとか
dialogue.content: Or annoying.

dialogue.origin: みくさんの気持ち、きっと伝わりますよ
dialogue.content: I'm sure your feelings will get through to them.

dialogue.origin: みくさんは、友達思いなんだなあと感じます
dialogue.content: I can tell you're a very thoughtful friend.

dialogue.origin: 正直な気持ち、きっと伝わると思いますよ！
dialogue.content: I truly believe your honest feelings will get through to them!

dialogue.origin: 今日の相談は、他にはよかったですか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything else you'd like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: あ、はい大丈夫です
dialogue.content: Oh, no, I'm okay.

dialogue.origin: もし、また何かありましたら、また連絡くださいね、上手くいくこと祈ってます。応援してますよ！
dialogue.content: If anything else comes up, please feel free to reach out again. I'll be hoping things work out for you. I'm rooting for you!

dialogue.origin: はい、わかりました
dialogue.content: Okay, I understand.

dialogue.origin: それでは、失礼します。
dialogue.content: All right, take care.

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: （昨日に引き続き、ありがとうございました。勉強になりました。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you again for today, following on from yesterday. It was a great learning experience.)

dialogue.origin: （こちらこそありがとうございました！）
dialogue.content: (Thank you as well!)

dialogue.origin: （ロールプレイ終了させていただきますね。お疲れさまでした）
dialogue.content: (We'll end the role-play now. Good work.)

dialogue.origin: （お疲れ様でした）
dialogue.content: (Thank you.)

topic.sub: 友だちとの関係のトラブル
